newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 4.

text.p: Saudi Petrochemical Development Co Ltd (SPDC), a joint venture set up by Japanese and Saudi Arabian concerns, has started negotiations with its partner Saudi Basic Industries (SABIC) to work out details for a third stage of plant construction to expand ethylene production. A plant capitalised at $1.2 billion is expected to start operations from the year 2000. The two companies are expected to finalise the plan by mid-1997.

Deutsche Telekom AG, the world's third-largest telecoms company, is to list its shares on the foreign section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on November 19. The company hopes to raise more than 100 billion yen in the exchange. Daiwa Securities Co Ltd will be the lead manager.

Sapporo Breweries Ltd has agreed with Taiwanese food trader Togn Hsun Hsin Trading Co to set up an equally owned joint venture brewery to produce Sapporo brand beer in Taiwan. The company, capitalised at about 12 billion yen, will sell beer from 1999.
